summary.name: SmoothCSV
summary.one_liner: SmoothCSV is a CSV editor and viewer with a spreadsheet-like interface for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
use_cases: Editing CSV files in a spreadsheet-like view
Opening and viewing large CSV files
Finding and replacing text across CSV data
summary.what_it_does:
SmoothCSV lets you edit CSV files through an intuitive spreadsheet-like interface. It offers find and replace, sorting and filtering of data, SQL queries, and multi-cell editing. A command palette provides quick access to its functions. The page says it handles large CSV files quickly. It is available for Windows, macOS, and Linux.</what_it_does>
